brief:
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu cautioned against what he characterized as a "leftist alliance with the Muslim Brotherhood," directing his criticism at Arab parties operating within Palestinian territories, according to Shehab Wire. He did not elaborate on the specific mechanisms of such an alleged alliance or provide evidence for the claim.

In the same statement, Netanyahu reaffirmed his commitment to blocking Palestinian statehood. His warning reflects longstanding rhetoric from the Israeli right linking Arab political movements to regional Islamist organizations, a connection Arab parties within Israel have consistently rejected as a mischaracterization of their positions and platforms.
